entries.title: Merge cards show before and after pictures of what changed
entries.body: When a crewmate offers a change you can see, its card now shows a picture of each changed view as it was and as it is now, as many as the change needs. Something new carries a New tag and needs no picture of before. A change with nothing to see says why in one sentence.

picture.alt: A crewmate's merge card with a picture under Before and a picture marked New under After
